title: System
items: What type of I/O processing mechanism does IBM Storage FlashSystem use?
Active-active, where either node can process I/O for a volume
Active-passive, where only one node processes I/O
IBM Storage FlashSystem 為 Active-active 雙 Controller，同一 Volume 可由任一 Node 處理 I/O。
In an active-passive system, what happens when the passive node receives I/O?
It forwards the I/O to the active node
Active-passive 只有一個 Node 處理 I/O，另一個收到時轉送給作用中的 Node。
How does the path model relate to the I/O processing mechanism?
It is independent; paths can be optimized (preferred) or non-optimized
Paths determine which node processes I/O
Paths are only used for FC
Path 可分為 Optimized (Preferred) 與 Non-optimized，與 I/O 處理機制無關。
What forms an I/O group in an enclosure-based system?
The two nodes (node canisters) in the same control enclosure
One node and one expansion enclosure
同一 Enclosure 內的兩個 Node (Node Canister) 組成一個 I/O Group。
When is a write acknowledged to the host in an I/O group?
After the data is copied to the partner node, before it is written to the drives
After it is written to the drives
Before copying to the partner node
寫入先複製到 Partner Node 後才回應 Host，稍後才實際寫入 Drive。
If no preferred node is specified when creating a volume, which node is chosen?
The node with the fewest volumes
未指定 Preferred Node 時，系統選擇 Volume 最少的 Node。
When can the preferred node of a volume change?
Only when the volume is moved to another I/O group
Preferred Node 只能在 Volume 移到其他 I/O Group 時改變。
How many I/O groups can a node belong to?
Node 成對部署形成 I/O Group，每個 Node 只能屬於一個 I/O Group。
Does IBM FlashSystem support systems with more than one I/O group in V9.2.0?
No; SAN Volume Controller supports multiple I/O groups only on long-term support releases
IBM FlashSystem 不支援多於一個 I/O Group 的系統；SVC 僅在 Long-term Support Release 支援多個 I/O Group。
The single node at any time that is the focal point for configuration commands
The node with the most volumes
The node at the third site
任一時間由單一 Node 擔任 Configuration Node，作為設定指令的聚焦點，失效時由其他 Node 接手。
What is the tie-break role of a quorum device?
When a SAN failure splits the system in half, it decides which half continues
SAN 故障使 Node 剛好各半時，先存取 Quorum Device 的一組成為擁有者並繼續處理 I/O。
How many active quorum devices exist at a time?
同一時間只有一個 Active Quorum Device。
How many quorum devices can be used to store system configuration backups, and how much space does each reserve?
Up to three, each reserving slightly more than 256 MB
最多使用三個 Quorum Device 存放系統設定備份，每個保留略多於 256 MB。
What is an IP quorum application?
A Java application that runs on a server separate from the storage system
A firmware module on the nodes
IP Quorum Application 是在儲存系統之外的 Server 上執行的 Java 應用程式。
What is a partnership IP quorum used for?
Arbitration for policy-based HA partnerships only
Tie-break for a single system only
System IP Quorum 用於單一系統 Tie-break；Partnership IP Quorum 僅用於 Policy-based HA Partnership 的仲裁。
How many IP quorum applications can be deployed for a single system?
單一系統最多可部署 5 個 IP Quorum Application。
What must exist before a partnership IP quorum can be generated and deployed?
必須先建立 Partnership，才能產生並部署 Partnership IP Quorum。
Which system topology places all nodes at the same site?
Standard Topology 所有 Node 位於同一站點；Stretched 的 I/O Group 各 Node 位於不同站點，僅 SVC 提供。
Which system layer can provide external storage to a replication layer system?
Storage Layer 系統可為 Replication Layer 系統提供 External Storage，反之不行。
Can a replication layer system provide external storage to other IBM Storage Virtualize systems?
Replication Layer 系統不能為其他 IBM Storage Virtualize 系統提供 External Storage，但可使用 Storage Layer 系統當 External Storage。
What is the default system layer for the FlashSystem family?
FlashSystem 系列預設為 Replication Layer，可以變更。
External Virtualization 以 Storage Capacity Unit (SCU) 計價。
What must be configured to use policy-based replication?
使用 Policy-based Replication 需設定 I/O Group Bitmap 記憶體。
What are the two limits for volume group snapshots?
Production Capacity Allowance (PCA) and Snapshot Capacity Allowance (SCA)
Volume Group Snapshot 有 Production Capacity Allowance 與 Snapshot Capacity Allowance 兩個上限。
Which objects can throttles be applied to?
Hosts, host clusters, volumes, copy offload, and storage pools
Throttle 可用於 Host、Host Cluster、Volume、Copy Offload 與 Storage Pool，可設 IOPS、Bandwidth 或兩者。
Throttle 上限以每個 Node 計算，超出上限的 I/O 在接收的 Node 排隊。
When multiple throttles apply to an I/O, which applies?
多個 Throttle 同時適用時，採最嚴格者。
Before shutting down or deleting a node, what should you confirm?
That the partner node can take over all I/O
That the system is in stretched topology
關閉或刪除 Node 前，先確認 Partner Node 能接手所有 I/O。
What should you record before deleting a node?
Node serial number, WWNN, all WWPNs, and its I/O group
刪除前記錄 Node 序號、WWNN、所有 WWPN 與所屬 I/O Group；加回時須回到同一 I/O Group，否則可能資料毀損。
After a node is deleted, what mode does the remaining partner node enter?
Write-through, until a new node is added
刪除時預設先 Flush Cache，剩下的 Partner Node 進入 Write-through，直到有新 Node 加入。
Takes the node offline without flushing the cache, which can take dependent volumes offline
`rmnode -force` 不 Flush Cache 就讓 Node 離線，相依 Volume 會 Offline。
What happens if you delete the last node of a system?
It is equivalent to destroying the system
刪除系統的最後一個 Node 等同銷毀系統。
How do you release a node from service state?
被移除的 Node 回到 candidate 會自動重新加入；在 service state 的 Node 用 Exit Service State 釋放。
When shutting down the whole system, what indicates that nodes are ready to have power removed?
先停止 Host I/O，執行 `stopsystem`，等所有 Node 的 Power LED 以 1 Hz 閃爍，再拔除電源線。
Both boot drives match each other but not the system board
Boot drives are swapped between slots
Single boot drive booted from slot 2
545：兩個 Boot Drive 識別相同但與主機板不同；更換過 Canister 時執行 `satask chbootdrive -replacecanister`。
A boot drive belongs to another node slot, such as slots 1 and 2 swapped
The boot drive is out of sync
744：一個 Boot Drive 的識別資訊屬於另一 Slot，例如 Slot 1 與 2 互換，應放回正確 Slot。
How do you synchronize an out-of-sync boot drive when can_sync is Yes?
Use the Service Assistant or satask chbootdrive -sync
Drive 為 out of sync 且 can_sync 為 Yes 時，用 Service Assistant 或 `satask chbootdrive -sync` 同步。
How should SAS cables between expansion enclosures be connected?
One end to port 1 and the other end to port 2
Expansion Enclosure 之間的纜線一端接 Port 1、另一端接 Port 2。
Which node canister SAS ports connect the control enclosure to an expansion enclosure?
Port 3 or 4 on the node canister, to port 1 on the expansion
Port 1 or 2 on the node canister
Control 端用 Node Canister 的 SAS Port 3 或 4，Expansion 端用 Port 1。
What happens when removing a control enclosure that holds FlashCopy bitmaps without resolving dependencies?
FlashCopy Bitmap 在其上時須先解除相依，否則目標 Volume 會 Offline。
When is the system configuration automatically backed up?
Daily at 01:00 on the configuration node
系統每天 01:00 在 Configuration Node 自動備份，寫入 /dumps/svcconfig/svc.config.backup.json。
Which command creates a manual configuration backup?
`svcconfig backup` 產生 .json、.sh 與 .log 三個檔案；備份期間不可有變更設定作業。
Does the configuration backup include volume data?
設定備份只包含設定，不含 Volume 資料，應用資料需另外備份。
What naming restriction applies to objects for configuration backup?
Object names cannot start with an underscore
Object 名稱不可以底線開頭，否則備份會有問題。
When should T3 recover system be used?
Only when all nodes have lost system state
T3 只在所有 Node 都失去系統狀態時使用，只要任一 Node 為 active 就不需要。
Why should you NOT perform node rescue before T3 recovery?
It loses the backup files needed for recovery
不要做 Node Rescue，否則會遺失 Recovery 需要的備份檔。
For T3 recovery, within what time before the failure must the last quorum time be?
最後 Quorum 時間須在故障前 30 分鐘內，最後備份須在故障前 24 小時內，否則聯絡 Support。
What should you do if T3 recovery fails?
Take no further action and contact Support
T3 failed 時不要再做任何動作，聯絡 Support。
After T3 recovery, what happens to snapshots and Safeguarded backups?
They are all deleted and must be re-created by policy schedules
T3 後 Snapshot 與 Safeguarded Backup 全被刪除，需依 Policy 排程重新建立。
T4 只 Restore 設定，每個階段都要完成前一步才能繼續。
